controlled_provenance_privacy.decision: User rejected retaining private workspace paths. Public export must replace them in derivative metadata and recompute transitive hashes. Original sealed evidence remains unchanged.

recommendations.action: Create a clean-history repository from a controlled allowlist. Do not copy .git or bulk-stage the original checkout.
Exclude raw completion captures, inspections, diagnostic stores, historical root review backups, upstream README/source copies, logs, credentials and runtime data.

Exclude the rejected private workspace-root disclosure. Preserve original sealed evidence unchanged. Prepare a separately labeled portable metadata derivative, with new exact hashes and origin-only trust, or omit the private metadata. A derivative is not the original seal or a new learning run.
Set an owner-approved source license and copyright attribution before public release.
Retain third-party licenses, pinned references and dependency lockfiles. Keep provider weights, upstream jars and installed runtimes outside the source repository.
Sanitize maintained prose and map data outside approved sealed evidence, and scan the final export plus its one-commit history independently.
Use the user-approved public contact and biography. Do not inherit unrelated old author identities or private machine details.

derivative_review_requirements: A separate public origin tuple may identify exact sanitized metadata. Do not add it to historical execution terminal exemptions.
Current-source activation still requires a fresh local evaluator attestation, successful terminal, metrics, unchanged model bytes and settled cleanup.
Base integrity checks certify the derivative bytes only and must say they do not rerun original episodes.
Preserve model, ONNX, image and episode bytes; record any changed metadata with exact source and derivative hashes.
Run final private-path and credential scans plus qualification/portability negative tests against the public export.

gitleaks_false_positive_policy.requires: Rule-specific AND exceptions require exact controlled source-map paths and independently byte-verified source digests. Complete JSON key lines admit the Mac API checker or API correlation test digest. The known Mac checker digest also has an exact-secret allowance in PUBLICATION_BINDING.json only.
